records.title: POCSO Courts
details: It was inter-alia stated that a centrally Sponsored Scheme for the establishment of Fast Track Special Courts (FTSCs), including exclusive POCSO Courts for expeditious disposal of Rape and POCSO Act cases was introduced following the enactment of the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2018 and the order of Hon'ble Supreme Court in Suo Motu Writ (Criminal)No. 1/2019. The Scheme has been extended twice, with the latest extension up to 31st March, 2026, targeting the establishment of 790 courts. Under eCourts Phase III, there is a provision for enhancing and upgrading the available infrastructure of Video Conferencing in 10200 establishments including 500 Jails, 700 District Government Hospitals and 9000 Courts at an estimated cost of Rs. 228.48 crore.
